@common.sizeUnit.byte.sameAsSourceJustification: Swedish byte is invariant (1 byte / 2 byte, terms.json byte ruling; Swedish macOS Finder ”Noll byte”), so both branches read byte.

@common.sizeUnit.kibibyte.sameAsSourceJustification: Swedish keeps the IEC binary symbols unchanged (Microsoft terminology sv MiB and GiB, Dolphin sv MiB), kept distinct from the SI symbols.

@common.sizeUnit.kilobyte.sameAsSourceJustification: Swedish writes the SI symbol kB unchanged with the lowercase k (Nautilus sv 500 kB, Total Commander sv 64 kB), kept distinct from KiB.

@common.sizeUnit.megabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: Swedish writes the international unit symbols unchanged (Nautilus sv ”500 kB”, Swedish macOS Finder sizes), so the symbol stays verbatim.
